about: Labelled retrieval questions. Labels list the evidence IDs a careful reader would want for each question, judged by reading the evidence text (not generated from the material map). Written by the project build assistant before any retrieval run and not edited after results were seen; the file SHA-256 is recorded in results.json. Multi-hop questions name a spacecraft element (never its material), so answering requires going from the element to its components, their materials, and the NASA findings about them.
